metadata.title: Young People’s Perceptions of Europe in a Time of Change

survey_design.weight_fields_interpretation: This ICCS 2016 European regional report is based on the IEA’s large-scale survey design, which uses a complex sampling approach (students nested in schools and education systems). The report describes how the study collects comparable civic and citizenship measures across participating countries, and it provides guidance on scaling and reporting procedures for the resulting scores. Because this extracted text does not include the technical sampling/weighting variable names (e.g., student design weights or replicate weights), the specific weight variables and whether replicate-based variance estimation were applied cannot be confirmed from the provided excerpt. For analysts using the ICCS 2016 data, the appropriate approach is to apply the IEA-provided sampling weights and replicate weights (if available in the public-use materials) when producing country-comparable estimates and standard errors.

data.outcome_summary: This document is an IEA ICCS 2016 European regional report focused on young people’s perceptions of Europe in a time of change. It describes the study’s purpose and the role of the European regional student questionnaire supplement, which targets topics such as European identity, recent European political/social events (including immigration and freedom of movement), and European economic conditions and foreign policy. The excerpt does not provide the technical details needed to characterize the analytic approach (e.g., scaling model, plausible values, missing-data handling, or any predictive modeling). It also does not report any model performance metrics or target-variable-specific effects. As a result, the excerpt supports only a high-level understanding of the assessment scope and questionnaire content, not the quantitative ML results.
